description.zh:
过滤条件。有效值：

- ExpireTimeStart：预付费资源到期时间的查询开始时间
><notice>只支持私有化部署服务实例查询。></notice>
- ExpireTimeEnd：预付费资源到期时间的查询结束时间
><notice>只支持私有化部署服务实例查询。></notice>

- PayType：付费类型。><notice>只支持私有化部署服务实例查询。></notice>
有效值：
   - Subscription：预付费。
   - PayAsYouGo：后付费。


- ResourceARN：资源ARN（Aliyun

 Resource Name）。
description.en:
The filter conditions. Valid values:

- ExpireTimeStart: The start of the time range to query the expiration time of subscription resources.
  ><notice>This parameter applies only to service instances in private deployments.></notice>

- ExpireTimeEnd: The end of the time range to query the expiration time of subscription resources.
  ><notice>This parameter applies only to service instances in private deployments.></notice>

- PayType: The billing method.><notice> This parameter applies only to service instances in private deployments.></notice>
  Valid values:

  - Subscription: subscription.

  - PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go.

- ResourceARN: The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the resource.

resource name (ARN).

description.zh:
过滤器名称，可选择一个或者多个名称进行查询。取值范围：

- ExpireTimeStart
- ExpireTimeEnd
- PayType 
- ResourceARN
description.en:
The name of the filter. Valid values:

- ExpireTimeStart

- ExpireTimeEnd

- PayType

- ResourceARN

description.zh: 分页查询时每页行数。每页最大行数100行，默认行数20行。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

description.zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值。
description.en: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. Set this to the NextToken value from a previous API call.
The ID of the service instance.

description.zh:
服务实例资源类型。可能的值：

- AliyunResource：阿里云资源。

- ContainerResource：容器组（Pod）资源。
description.en:
The resource type of the service instance. Valid values:

- AliyunResource: an Alibaba Cloud resource.

- ContainerResource: a container group (pod) resource.
The key of the resource tag.
The value of the resource tag.

title.zh: 查询服务实例包含的资源

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenest list-service-instance-resources --max-results 20 --next-token AAAAAc3HCuYhJi/wvpk4xOr0VLbAx7BkQzyYC+ONO+WudHGKEdB0uWSY7AGnM3qCgm/Ynge7zU6NWdbj0Tegyajyqyc= --service-instance-id si-d8a0cc2a1ee04dce0000 --tag Value=value1 Key=key1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-instance-resource-type AliyunResource --filters '[{"Values":["2022-01-01T12:00:00_Z"],"Name":"ExpireTimeStart"}]' --region cn-hangzhou
